description: This file defines the class NotStrictlyPositiveException, a custom exception indicating that a provided number argument is not strictly positive. It extends NumberIsTooSmallException and includes constructors for different ways of instantiation.

classes.name: NotStrictlyPositiveException
classes.description: Exception to be thrown when an argument is not strictly greater than zero.

methods.name: NotStrictlyPositiveException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Localizable for context and a Number argument.
